questions.question: What should you do if your vehicle gets stuck on railroad tracks?

options.text: Get out of the vehicle and call for help.
Keep trying to get your vehicle off the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of the vehicle and call for help.
questions.explanation: Leave your vehicle immediately and move away from the tracks. Look for emergency contact information on the signposts at the crossing. Call 911 or another emergency number.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a driving hazard?

options.text: A police car helping a motorist on the side of the road

questions.explanation: Accidents distract drivers and create danger. Ice cream trucks attract children who may not watch for traffic. An open road is not a hazard.

questions.question: A person working on a broken-down vehicle on the road shoulder:

options.text: Will pay close attention to traffic.
May be focused on the repair and not notice traffic.
Does not need to follow traffic laws.

questions.correctAnswerText: May be focused on the repair and not notice traffic.
questions.explanation: Be careful when driving near people fixing broken-down vehicles. They are focused on their work and may not see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Too much air pressure in a tire:
questions.explanation: Never overinflate your tires. Always check your tire pressure with a gauge during vehicle inspections.

questions.question: The main reason to inspect your vehicle before a trip is:
questions.explanation: Vehicle inspections protect you and others on the road. Safety checks before every trip are required by law.

questions.question: Mirror adjustment can only be checked correctly if:

options.text: The vehicle is on a slight hill.

questions.explanation: For vehicles with trailers, mirrors must be checked when the trailers are straight. Check mirrors before every trip.

questions.question: Over-the-counter medication:

options.text: Is not covered by driving laws.
Can make it unsafe to drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can make it unsafe to drive.
questions.explanation: Over-the-counter and prescription medications can have side effects that impair driving. It is illegal to drive while impaired by any substance, including some over-the-counter medications.

questions.question: To stop your vehicle from rolling backward when you start moving, you can:

options.text: Partly engage the clutch before lifting your foot off the brake.
Use the parking brake when stopped.

questions.correctAnswerText: Partly engage the clutch before lifting your foot off the brake.
questions.explanation: To prevent your vehicle from rolling backward, partly engage the clutch before removing your foot from the brake pedal.

questions.question: If a bus leans toward the outside of a curved road, the bus is:
questions.explanation: Always slow down when entering a curve. If a bus leans toward the outside of a curve, it is going too fast.

questions.question: Before operating a bus, you should check that the:

options.text: Floor lining is easy to remove.

questions.explanation: When checking a bus interior, make sure everything is safe and working properly. Emergency exits must be clearly marked and easy to use.

questions.question: Your brakes fail while driving downhill. What is the best way to stop?

options.text: Let the vehicle slow down on its own.
Use rumble strips to slow your vehicle.

questions.explanation: If your brakes fail going downhill, use an escape ramp to stop your vehicle. If no ramp is available, drive into an open field or side road that is flat or goes uphill.

questions.question: If your vehicle has an inspection report, you should:

options.text: Not read it and find problems yourself instead.
Take the vehicle to a mechanic.
Skip your own inspection and only rely on the report.

questions.explanation: Start your vehicle inspection by reading the last inspection report. The mechanic should have fixed any problems listed in the report.

questions.question: Most heavy trucks with manual transmissions need ____ to shift gears.
questions.explanation: Most heavy trucks with manual transmissions require double clutching to shift gears. This skill takes practice to master.

questions.question: What is the best way to avoid cell phone distractions while driving?

options.text: Stay on one call for the entire trip.
Turn off your phone before driving.
Only use your phone to accept incoming calls.
Text instead of talk on the phone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off your phone before driving.
questions.explanation: The best way to avoid cell phone distractions is to turn off your phone before you start driving and leave it off until you reach your destination.

questions.question: Which one does NOT cause hydraulic brake failure?
questions.explanation: Hydraulic brake failure usually happens for two reasons: loss of hydraulic pressure or overuse on long hills, which causes brake fade.

questions.question: When exiting your vehicle, you must:

options.text: Keep four points of contact with the vehicle.
Face the road before you finish exiting.

questions.explanation: When exiting your vehicle during a driving test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. On a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may cause you to fail the basic control skills test.

questions.question: Cargo in a trailer must be:

options.text: Stacked no higher than three feet.
Loaded with heavy items on top of lighter items.

questions.explanation: Cargo must be secured to keep it from moving during transport. Load it to keep the vehicle's center of gravity low and balanced.

questions.question: Routine vehicle inspections are done to ensure:
questions.explanation: The most important reason to inspect your vehicle is to keep yourself and other drivers safe.

questions.question: When the bus arrives at a stop, tell passengers all of the following, EXCEPT:

options.text: How many passengers should exit the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: How many passengers should exit the bus.
questions.explanation: At a stop, announce the location, the reason for stopping, the next departure time, and the bus number.

questions.question: Before a trip, make sure that:

options.text: The grooved pedal surface is not worn smooth.

questions.correctAnswerText: The grooved pedal surface is not worn smooth.
questions.explanation: Check that nothing blocks the pedals. Make sure the pedals work properly and that grooved surfaces are not worn smooth.
